title: A bounded Azure avatar session observed in WebKit
sourceBinding: An existing recorded service session, not an execution of this checkout. The original report hash identifies the source record, not this derived JSON.

metrics.name: total_video_frames
metrics.method: HTMLVideoElement.getVideoPlaybackQuality totalVideoFrames; this total can include dropped frames and is not a decoded-frame count

metrics.name: evaluation_duration
metrics.method: Monotonic wall time including authorization, checks and closure

metrics.name: browser_response_count
metrics.method: Observed application response bodies; response headers, URLs and console events also inspected

metrics.name: browser_boundary_findings
metrics.method: Bounded in-memory raw, URL-encoded and base64 pattern inspection, including configured resource identifiers

metrics.name: response_inspection_errors
metrics.method: Unreadable expected response bodies count as errors, not clean results

metrics.name: protocol_bodyless_responses
metrics.method: HEAD, 204/205/304 and redirect responses; headers and URLs still inspected

metrics.name: azure_auth_websockets_in_browser
metrics.method: Observed browser WebSocket connections, not inferred from HTTP

checks.details: Recorded run: 606 decoded frames, increasing frame callbacks and 1920 x 1080 native video dimensions. The separate totalVideoFrames counter was 610 and can include dropped frames.
Recorded run: 150,615 inbound audio bytes; the counter increased during synthesis.
The authenticated server-side synthesis request completed in the recorded session.
Twelve response bodies plus headers, URLs and console events inspected in this bounded run: zero findings and zero inspection errors. This is not an exhaustive security assessment.
All four anonymous avatar operations returned 401; authenticated cross-origin preparation returned 403 before starting a session.
Authenticated status confirmed that the recorded operator session was no longer active after explicit closure.

limitations: Selected checks and unchanged measurements from one WebKit 26.6 run on macOS; no claim that the current checkout, every browser or every network has passed a live run.
The boundary inspection covers observed application responses, URLs and console events, not all browser memory or every possible encoding.
SDP, ephemeral TURN/ICE credentials and media network addresses remain visible to an authorized operator.
The browser-authentication baseline is an invented, nonfunctional fixture, never a live credential exposure.
A stock-avatar still is recorded service output, not a new service invocation, a live stream or original filmed footage.
The native totalVideoFrames counter includes decoded and potentially dropped frames; it must not be reported as 610 decoded frames.
